sections.content:
When imagining ideal scenarios or talking about possibilities that depend on future circumstances, the conditional paints the picture:

• ¿Cómo sería tu viaje perfecto? (What would your perfect trip be like?)
• Sería maravilloso viajar por los Andes. (It would be wonderful to travel through the Andes.)

sections.title: Imagining the Future
rows: Viviría en una casa frente al mar.

items.spanish: Con un mes libre, recorreríamos toda la Patagonia.
items.english: With a free month, we would tour all of Patagonia.

items.spanish: Sería un sueño hecho realidad conocer las ruinas mayas.
items.english: It would be a dream come true to visit the Mayan ruins.
